IS 3908 : 2025 Aluminium Beam, Channel and Angle Sections - Dimensions and Properties
ICS 77.150.10
ICS 77.150.10
CED 07
CED 07
(Amalgamating IS 3909, IS 3921 and IS 5384)
1 SCOPE
This standard covers the material, dimensions and sectional properties of aluminium equal leg angle, unequal leg angle, channel and ‘I’ beam sections for structural use and other applications.
2 REFERENCES
The standards given below contain provisions, which through reference in this text constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreement based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of these standards:
